subject: Fix #6 - Make the compiler flags configurable (#23)
reason: The change is build/CI-only: it makes compiler flags overridable in CMakeLists.txt and build.sh (defaulting to the same -g -O3 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -Wall -Werror -Wextra flags as before), fixes a CI typo, and updates README and the integration-test runner's shell quoting. No source file of the module changes, so there is no runtime behaviour — commands, replies, data, replication or persistence — that a scenario could reach or distinguish between the two builds.
